acceptance.edge: Both partitions verified-edge precision >=0.98 and recall >=0.25.
acceptance.evidence: Per-hypothesis qualification, per-edge audit, metrics CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG, provenance, logs and SHA-256 seal.
acceptance.isolation: Zero optimizer/model inference/update and zero C09/C10/M-TARE reads.
acceptance.method: No threshold grid, no changed 4m online radius, no predicted untraversed edge, and C07-C08 explicitly marked development selection.
acceptance.node: Both C01-C06 and C07-C08 objective node precision >=0.98, recall >=0.25 and false-loop fraction <=0.01.
acceptance.sources: Exactly 80 worlds, 252430 route frames, 16078 declared/16076 framed traversals and the two declared zero-sequence traversals; all C01-C08 axis files independently match the dataset seal.

approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.
approval.scope: One immutable C01-C08 development-capacity replay using completed route endpoint geometry; zero training/inference/C09/C10/M-TARE.

methods.baseline: Sealed factorized-hybrid endpoint inventory before execution-anchor qualification: fit node P 0.980510 and edge P 0.833333; C07-C08 node/edge P 1.0.
methods.fallback: If either development partition misses node/edge precision 0.98 or recall 0.25, stop before C09 and inventory the remaining mechanism; do not tune an angle or distance threshold.
methods.main: Frozen union association and factorized support, completed-route endpoint anchor consensus, parameter-free two-edge branch witness, exact endpoint duplicate union, and execution-verified edge remap.

operation: read-only C01-C08 graph development-capacity replay; no training or threshold grid
purpose: Test whether completed-route endpoint anchors and an observed branch witness close the three residual fit-edge safety failures without changing learned proposals, online radius or edge generation.
retention: Retain compact graph audits, all paper figure formats, provenance, logs, metrics and seal.

sampling.independent_unit: One completed directed traversal endpoint and one post-commit hypothesis/verified edge

split_logic: C01-C06 and C07-C08 are development capacity only. C07-C08 confirmed the mechanism but selected no numeric threshold. C09 is untouched validation; C10 is strict test.

teacher.anchor_bound: Maximum two-endpoint error is 2 * fixed 1m route sampling spacing; no fitted tolerance.
teacher.branch_witness: At least three executed physical incidences, or for exactly two, positive outward-vector dot product; no angle threshold grid.
teacher.posthoc: Objective TNG node/edge identities are read only after replay for one-to-one 4m scoring.
teacher.runtime: No TNG identity or objective center. Runtime consumes learned event center side, completed route endpoint anchors/directions, old factorized pair support and physical incidence.
